verses.text: For the music director. A psalm of David. Happy is the person who cares about the poor. The LORD will rescue him in times of trouble.
The LORD will protect him and keep him alive. He will be blessed in the land. The LORD will not hand him over to what his enemies want.
The LORD will hold him up when he is sick in bed, and will bring him back to health.
I said, "LORD, be kind to me! Heal me, because I have sinned against you."
My enemies say evil things about me: "When will he die and his name be forgotten?"
When one of them comes to visit me, he says things he does not mean. In his heart he collects bad news, and when he leaves, he tells everyone.
All who hate me whisper together about me. They imagine the worst for me.
They say, "He has a terrible disease. He is lying down and will never get up again."
Even my close friend, someone I trusted, who ate my bread, has turned against me.
But you, LORD, be kind to me. Raise me up so I can pay them back.
I know that you are pleased with me, because my enemy does not win over me.
You hold me up because I am innocent, and you keep me with you forever.
Praise the LORD, the God of Israel, forever and ever! Amen and amen.
